note: Every fault the QA owner knows about. A finding stays open until a named check proves the fix. `npm run qa:inventory` counts the open ones.

findings.title: A key press is spent on a pause the original would end by itself
findings.detail: The game empties its keyboard buffer before drawing a new screen (FlushKeys, START.EXE 26b:f6) and after each key (26b:48). The runner blocks at those polls and waits for the player. The key it receives is discarded, so the player presses again. Seen as B twice at Begin Adventuring, E twice for Encamp, and an extra Enter when leaving an area.
findings.source: Owner report, reproduced with a key trace on 2026-11-21.
findings.resolution: The runner no longer asks the player for a key at the game's discard polls (tools/live-input.ts). Under the old behaviour the full campaign replay had 101 of 992 key presses thrown away.

findings.title: The replays press a key until the screen changes, which hides swallowed keys
findings.detail: tools/verify-fresh-party.mjs uses [key, until, limit] actions, and tools/verify-slums-presentation.mjs has `if still on the area menu, press E again`. An acceptance step must press once and assert. Measured on 2026-11-21: 101 discarded presses across the 11 legs of the full campaign replay. The older harnesses now set POR_INPUT_COMPAT=discard-poll-prompt and stay on the old input mode until each replay is re-recorded with one press per input. The presentation replays are unmeasured.

findings.title: In Enhanced, lowercase j opens the journal where the game wants the letter
findings.detail: Typing a character name, and the party menu, whose key set is C D M T V A R L S B E J. The runner only exempts jewelry appraisal, Join Tyranthraxus and the disk menus.
findings.source: Side-agent note and code reading. Not yet reproduced in play.
findings.resolution: The page takes J as the journal shortcut only at the exploration and Camp menus, which do not use J. Elsewhere the key goes to the game. Name entry itself is not yet exercised by a check.

findings.title: In Enhanced, lowercase m opens the map and never reaches the game
findings.detail: Move in combat, Magic in the Camp menu, Mins in Rest, and Modify at the party menu all use M. tools/play.js toggles the map first.
findings.source: Code reading. Not yet reproduced in play.
findings.resolution: The page takes M as the map shortcut only at the exploration menus. At the Camp menu M opens Magic. Move in combat is not yet exercised by a check.

findings.title: The original's Ctrl key commands never reach the game
findings.detail: The game's key routine (START.EXE image 26f8) acts on Ctrl-S (sound on and off), Ctrl-D and Ctrl-C. The page drops every Ctrl combination. Tab and key auto-repeat are dropped too, and the numeric keypad can never send digits.

findings.title: A blocking key read with nothing queued returns Enter
findings.detail: src/runtime/dos.ts answers 0x1c0d when no key is waiting. In live play the runner always supplies a key first, so this only fires before the live step. It still needs a check that it cannot fire in play.

findings.title: A portrait sometimes shows inside another portrait
findings.detail: Mechanism not yet established. 47 Enhanced portrait and illustration PNGs contain transparent pixels, which let the original picture show through; whether that is the cause is unproven.

findings.title: Every frame of an animated portrait must play as a loop in Chrome
findings.detail: Replacement art exists for three- and four-frame animations. The bar is that it looks right in Chrome, not that it matches the original's frame timing.

findings.title: Every combat message must appear
findings.detail: Combat messages went missing in the past. Believed fixed, never proven.

findings.title: The original's palette changes are ignored
findings.detail: int 10h AH=10h has no case in src/runtime/video.ts. The game calls it from the title sequence and from combat effects (START.EXE image 4f59, slices 1 and 32). Display-page selection (AH=05h) is ignored too.
findings.source: Research pass over the platform layer.

findings.title: The reproduced Classic sound WAV files are not in this repository
findings.detail: They are in TSavo/por-assets under original/. A release of this repository alone is silent in Classic.

findings.title: Establish what the port does with the translation-wheel check
findings.detail: GAME.OVR slice 2 asks for a code word from the printed wheel. The campaign replay never types one. Either the check is not reached, or the supplied game files skip it. A player without the wheel must not be blocked.

findings.title: Three DOS calls in the translated code would stop the game if reached
findings.detail: Set Date, Set Time and Rename (int 21h AH=2Bh, 2Dh, 56h). No translated caller was found.

findings.title: Choosing Silent for Classic hardware also silences Enhanced effects
findings.detail: tools/play.js returns before checking for an Enhanced replacement.

findings.title: The Dialogue volume slider controls nothing
findings.detail: Every voice line and queued clip is typed narration.

findings.title: The Rolf tour MP3 files are served as audio/wav
findings.detail: tools/browser-play.ts /voice/ route.

findings.title: A failed character-sheet image drops the whole frame to Classic
findings.detail: The character-sheet-part layer is not in the page's handled fallback list.

findings.title: Documents that no longer match the code
findings.detail: upgrades/README.md describes a viewport key the loader rejects and a 59-tile Slums pack. README.md says the keypad needs Num Lock off. docs/ecl.md and src/lib/ecl.ts give the Curse of the Azure Bonds opcode table; the real dispatch handles 0x00 to 0x3D except 0x1F. docs/AUDIO.md says 1,745 recordings where the manifest has 1,739 files.

findings.title: The walkthrough describes version 1.3; the supplied program is an earlier build
findings.detail: The Stephen S. Lee guide (v2.00, 2026-04-02) is written for IBM v1.3. Compared with a v1.3 copy (Internet Archive POR_POR), all 113 shared data files are identical and 28 of 29 script blocks are identical. The New Phlan script (ECL3 block 0) is 3 bytes longer in v1.3. START.EXE and GAME.OVR differ, and v1.3 uses a different overlay format. Our credits show no version, which the guide says means v1.0. So scripted steps apply except for one New Phlan edit still to be located, and every engine-level claim in the guide must be confirmed against our program.

findings.title: The original's STING start-up mode is part of the program
findings.detail: Launching the original with the argument STING enables Ctrl-C quit, Ctrl-D hit-point debug, Alt-X win combat and J to train for free, and skips the intro and copy protection. That explains the J in the party menu's key set. Decide whether the port exposes it, and check that J does nothing at the party menu without it.
findings.source: Guide research and the strings in START.EXE.

findings.title: 1,045 presentation replays need checkpoint saves that are not in the repository
findings.detail: Only new-phlan-rolf-approach runs from a fresh game. No code maps a replay to the command that produces its checkpoint.

findings.title: No check compares the translated game's behaviour with the original program
findings.detail: Every replay compares against expectations the port wrote, the original data files, or its own earlier recording. The one check that runs original code covers the sound driver only.

findings.title: Three commissions are asserted by no replay
findings.detail: commission-graveyard, commission-gate and commission-cadorna. The full campaign replay asserts only sokal and castle.

findings.title: Our build can announce Tavern Tale 24, which does not exist
findings.detail: New Phlan's tavern code draws 1 to 24. Version 1.3 draws 1 to 23, matching the 23 tales in the Adventurer's Journal.

findings.title: Translate version 1.3 and make it the game the port runs
findings.detail: Owner decision on 2026-11-21. Version 1.3 is what GOG sells and what the walkthrough documents. 73% of our procedures are the same or nearly the same in it, the scripts differ in one place, and the data is identical. The work: translator support for EXEPACK and the FBOV overlay file, a named table of every code and data address the host uses, and the same checks passing on 1.3.

findings.title: Crt.Delay ends after one pass
findings.detail: A named exception in the generator. The owner ruled on 2026-11-21 that timing is not a QA priority for a turn-based game.
